review.method: Official documentation and static source inspection, including Boss death, Rift victory, Bond selection and fusion. No gameplay session claimed.

itemNotes.choiceband: Locks ordinary slot switching. If your active slot is a Bond group, its linked moves can still run together.
itemNotes.shellbell: Damage dealt adds 4% to a healing reserve capped at 4 HP. That reserve is released at up to 4 HP per second.
itemNotes.lifeorb: Each affected cast costs the larger of 1 HP and 1% of max HP, stopping at 1 HP. Orbit and trail casts are excluded from this charge.
itemNotes.assaultvest: Adds 20 percentage points of damage reduction. Total player damage reduction is capped at 80%.

steps.title: Win the Rift fight
steps.description: Defeat the legendary inside its Rift arena. Each victory adds one Bond. An ordinary map Boss does not grant one.

steps.title: Return to the main map
steps.description: The fusion choice opens after you leave the arena. If another choice screen is open, it waits until that screen closes.

steps.title: Pair two learned moves
steps.description: Without an unfinished group, choose two moves currently in separate slots. They become one slot and both run while that slot is active.

steps.title: Grow the unfinished group
steps.description: If a group already contains two or three moves, the next Bond adds one loose move to it. Four is the group limit. Once a group is full, another Bond can start a new pair if two loose moves remain.

notes: A Bond combines learned moves. It does not teach a Boss attack, add a fifth ordinary move slot or automatically evolve either move.
Fusion keeps the existing move objects, including their levels and evolution state. Their attacks use their own cooldowns; they do not share one new cooldown.
With only one loose move and no unfinished group, the Bond is saved until you learn another eligible move. Returning without a victory does not award a Bond.
Choice Band still blocks ordinary slot switching. Fusion keeps the current active slot if that slot survives the merge; otherwise it selects the fused group.

equipment.description: Standard map Bosses and Rift legendaries drop a held item. Chests can also provide equipment. You can carry only one at a time; finding another opens a choice to keep your current item or replace it.
equipment.exclusions: Judgment enemies are excluded from the standard Boss equipment-drop branch. Equipment is separate from move slots, evolution stat-card requirements and Rift Bonds.

patterns.name: Area slam
patterns.description: A circular shockwave around the Boss. Leave the marked area before the hit.

patterns.name: Straight charge
patterns.description: The Boss charges along the line aimed at you when the cast starts. Move sideways out of that line.

patterns.name: Leaping strike
patterns.description: A jump toward your marked position, followed by an area hit on landing. Keep moving away from the landing circle.

patterns.name: Falling zones
patterns.description: Several delayed impact circles appear around your position. Move into clear ground instead of crossing another marker.

patterns.name: Beam fan
patterns.description: Long beams spread toward your position. Read the lines on the ground and step into a gap before they fire.

patterns.name: Projectile volley
patterns.description: A fan of projectiles fires toward you after the charge-up. Keep an open escape route across the fan.

patterns.name: Radial burst
patterns.description: Projectiles spread outward in a ring. Keep enough distance to see a gap and move through it.
